comparison.scope: Source-only comparison of user controls, mode applicability and registered-tool roster/behavior; no build, test, browser, credentials, DB or sibling-repository inspection.

findings.feature: Scrape / capture and save current page
delta: Save is now organization-bound Source landing with refusal/outage retention and retry behavior; state is bound to the organization and capture, and stale asynchronous completions must not claim a save in a switched workspace.
The page can show a 'Not yet a Source' prompt with Capture or Save action; the unsaved retry card owns the sole save action for a held URL.

After a successful landing, a new optional FileSourcePanel allows filing into registered places and choosing a media-catalog Library; filing is a separate post-save action and can be closed without filing.
coverage_to_add_or_revise: EXT-F-1007-T21/T22/T23 from inventory-remote-delta.json remain relevant, but add positive/negative optional filing coverage: close without filing; select/remove multiple registered targets; choose/no Library; refusal and retry; verify filing cannot precede or undo Source landing.

Add source-delta cases for organization switch during in-flight Save, duplicate-control suppression while the retry card owns the URL, stale saved badge clearing across organizations, and optional filing request/result notices.
Reconcile source/page recognition plus current selected organization, including unknown/failed recognition and guest sign-in remedy.
findings.mode_notes: Guest, member and admin distinctions matter: Scrape is visible to guests; landing requires authentication and the selected device organization. Filing/library controls are shown after landing and need member/admin authorization coverage.

findings.feature: Search and manage saved captures / workspace Sources
delta: Saved Captures now presents organization Sources; list rows identify the capturing person as 'you', their name, or 'another member'.
Deletion is organization-wide for all members and removes the Source from the organization, while leaving the original web page unaffected; the confirmation copy now states this scope.
Source terminology and empty/error states changed; edit semantics represent Source portions while original capture remains distinct.
coverage_to_add_or_revise: Revise T03/T05 proposals in inventory-remote-delta.json for organization-wide Source semantics and current copy; verify captured-by identity and unreadable-name fallback.

Add an authorized member deletion case with a second member positive control confirming organization-wide removal; confirm original page is unaffected. Use real permission fixture and do not infer RLS behavior from extension code.
Retire or mark stale title/description standalone control IDs if still present; the editor now uses unified article-text editing.
findings.mode_notes: Saved Captures tab is signed-in only. Member and admin behavior both require current device organization and backend authorization; guest is a negative visibility case.

delta: Vault candidate lookup now distinguishes failure from a successful empty match list, gives a visible failure explanation and Retry, clears stale matches while retrying, and keys matching to the panel's resolved page URL.
Site matches are intersected with panel matches; the create-login form uses the resolved page URL.
coverage_to_add_or_revise: Add case: saved-login lookup outage is visibly distinct from no matching login; Retry recovers; stale candidates are not actionable during retry or after URL/tab changes.
Verify panel-resolved URL and current tab/actor matching agree, with positive exact-site match and negative non-match controls; preserve credential secrecy and never capture field values.
findings.mode_notes: Vault tab is signed-in only; exercise ordinary member and admin. Access and protected-field outcomes need the existing Vault contract and real backend authorization; no credentials were accessed for this audit.

findings.feature: Agenda task creation and organization-scoped education capture
delta: Agenda task-create failure now appears inline with an organization-selection remedy instead of only in debug logging.
Education study-set capture resolves and sends the active organization explicitly; missing selection returns a visible organization-required result.
coverage_to_add_or_revise: Add task-create failure/retry case with no organization selected and a positive case after selecting one; verify inline alert disappears/updates after recovery.
Add manual capture_study_set case proving missing organization does not write and selected organization is attached to the import; confirm tool result communicates remedy.
findings.mode_notes: Agenda is signed-in for member/admin; guest tab is omitted. Tool authorization still follows tool permissions and organization requirements. Backend persistence was not checked.

findings.feature: General chat model choice and account-default model setting
delta: The composer’s default model row now reads 'Your default' and resolves the account-level chat_default_model for general chat when no local override is selected; built agents retain their own model.
Read-aloud voice resolution now uses the shared platform-knob reader, replacing a feature-local resolver/cache.
coverage_to_add_or_revise: Add cases for account default applied to general chat, explicit composer override taking precedence, built agent retaining its own model, unset account choice leaving the agent model intact, and read-aloud following the account voice setting/default.
Check organization selection, settings-read failure and recovery produce an honest result; source-only evidence does not certify platform-knob precedence or live model availability.
findings.mode_notes: Chat is available to guest/member/admin, but account settings and authenticated model execution differ by role. Existing chat/pilot full acceptance remains pending.

delta: Removing the desktop engine-port override now clears the stale visible error as well as rediscovering the engine.
coverage_to_add_or_revise: Keep EXT-D-0012 closure linked, and ensure any previously unverified Settings reset/recovery case includes error-clear then rediscovery behavior; old run evidence does not prove current source.
findings.mode_notes: Settings visibility is source-audience based; inventory currently marks guest/member/admin applicable. Confirm exact Settings availability by mode from current App gate before claiming runtime access.

tool_roster.catalog_diff_since_inventory_sha: Generated timestamp only; no roster membership/count change detected in types/tool-catalog.md.

tool_behavior_deltas.coverage: Existing credential-login outcomes should be considered stale for progress/stage diagnostics, but do not infer changed user-facing credential behavior solely from instrumentation. Verify refusal, success and no-secret-egress using the existing sensitive-flow contract when that lane runs.

tool_behavior_deltas.delta: Now requires the active organization and supplies p_organization_id; missing selection returns organization_required with a remedy.
tool_behavior_deltas.coverage: Covered as EXT-F-2004 recommendation above; no registered tool addition/removal detected.

tool_roster.stale_coverage: No inventory pass should be promoted from this source comparison. The existing 169 registered-tool feature entries remain a source roster count; tool descriptions live in the DB and this audit did not query the live DB.

stale_coverage_recommendation.rule: Preserve prior case IDs, run receipts and history. Mark materially changed/new controls and cases unverified against current origin/main; do not transfer source, unit, old-build or historical browser passes to current behavior.

completeness_limits: This is a source census, not runtime acceptance. No tests/build/browser launched and no live app, Supabase, backend or sibling repo was consulted.

The inventory source_sha is more than 150 commits behind current origin/main; many commits are infrastructure, bug fixes, tests or docs. This report prioritizes user-visible control and mode changes and cannot certify that every commit-level behavioral effect has been mapped to an inventory case.
Current tool catalog reports 169 tools and same membership/count versus its baseline diff; DB-only descriptions/bindings, runtime permission gates and backend tool availability were not checked.

Dynamic content, role-dependent gates, browser/platform API behavior, backend/RLS semantics, account knob values, and real user data may reveal controls or mode differences absent from static source inspection.
Some listed behaviors may already be represented by current inventory cases or later reports; this report recommends reconciliation against case/control IDs rather than blindly duplicating cases.
